description: Scan a local repository and report which files would be affected by changing one file: a breadth-first search over reverse import edges. Returns { changedFile, directDependents, transitiveDependents: [{ id, depth }], affectedClusters, blastRadius } where depth 1 means a direct importer, affectedClusters lists the directories touched, and blastRadius counts unique affected files excluding the changed file. Use it before editing, renaming or deleting a file to see who depends on it; use scan_repository_graph when you need the full graph, or generate_architecture_html for a visual. Every call performs its own fresh static scan of `path`; no prior scan is required. If changedFile is not found, the result is an error that lists the closest matching file ids so you can retry. Static analysis only: dynamic or computed imports and custom path aliases may be missed, and external packages are not tracked.

changedFile.description: The file whose callers you want, as a repository-relative path with forward slashes, e.g. "src/core/graph.ts" or "pkg/server/handler.go". An absolute path inside the repository is also accepted.

path.description: Absolute path to the repository root to scan, e.g. "/home/me/project" or "C:/dev/project". Relative paths resolve against the MCP server process working directory, which is usually not the project, so prefer absolute paths.

name: query_impact_path
title: Query impact path (blast radius) of a file
